title: bourdon · recognition-first memory for AI agents
excerpt: Every memory framework optimizes for retrieval. Bourdon optimizes for the felt experience of memory, the moment-by-moment shape of the response.
content_html:
pre-alpha · built in public

Memory that feels like being known.

Ask most AI tools about something you told them last week and you get a pause, a database lookup, and a reply that sounds like a search result. Bourdon works the way human memory does: it recognizes you instantly, starts responding, and pulls the details up in the background. One memory, shared by all your agents. What you tell one, the others already know.

the problem · today’s memory

Today’s AI memory is a filing cabinet. Yours isn’t.

When you see a familiar face you don’t freeze while you search your memories. You know them first, and the details arrive while you’re already saying hello. Today’s AI does the opposite: silence, search, then a reply. Bourdon puts the steps back in human order: recognition first, hydration second, archive descent third.

one memory, many agents

What you tell one, the others already know.

Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Devin write to and read from one shared, federated memory, so a fact learned by one is recognized by the rest, across accounts and machines. Your own agents join with a line of config. Gemini and Hermes adapters are on the way.

evidence · field tests

Evidence

Three field tests on live agents against real work.

how bourdon differs · positioning

run it your way · pricing

Self-host free. Or let us run the box.

Self-hosting is the default and it is the whole engine, cross-agent federation included. Managed hosting is coming for teams that would rather not run a box. The free to paid line is operations, never engine capability: you pay for uptime, not for features.

Federation is never gated. Cross-agent memory is the product, not an upsell. It is here at the free tier and it stays here.

the family · one instrument

Bourdon is one organ of a fleet instrument. Its sibling Positif is the cross-agent routing: what the fleet is allowed to do. Bourdon is the cross-agent memory: what the fleet knows. Tremulant is the conductor, for when the fleet acts on its own — and Prestant is the console in front of them all. Each with its own brand; one instrument.

content_html_zh:
预阿尔法 · 公共建筑

感觉就像被认识的记忆。

向大多数人工智能工具询问你上周告诉他们的事情，你会得到暂停，进行数据库查找，然后得到听起来像搜索结果的答复。 波登的工作方式与人类记忆的工作方式相同：它会立即识别出您，开始做出响应，并在后台提取详细信息。 一份记忆，由所有特工共享。 你告诉一个人什么，其他人就已经知道了。

问题·今天的记忆

今天的人工智能存储器是一个文件柜。 你的不是。

当你看到熟悉的面孔时，你在搜索记忆时不会僵住。 您首先了解他们，当您打招呼时，详细信息就会到达。 今天的人工智能则相反：沉默、搜索，然后回复。 波登将这些步骤放回了人类的顺序：识别第一，水合作用第二，档案血统第三。

human: speaks.       human: speaks again.
   |                    |
   v                    v
(silence, retrieval, search...)
   |                    |
   v                    v
ai: replies.         ai: replies.

一份记忆，多种代理人

你告诉一个人什么，其他人就已经知道了。

Claude、Codex、Cursor、Copilot 和 Devin 在一个共享的联合内存中进行写入和读取，因此一个人了解到的事实可以被其他人跨账户和机器识别。 您自己的代理通过一行配置加入。 Gemini 和 Hermes 适配器即将推出。

证据·现场测试

证据

针对真实工作对现场代理进行三项现场测试。

波登有何不同·定位

按您的方式运行 · 定价

免费自托管。 或者让我们运行这个盒子。

自托管是默认设置，它是整个引擎，包括跨代理联合。 托管托管适用于那些不想运行盒子的团队。 免费到付费的路线是运营，而不是引擎功能：您为正常运行时间付费，而不是为功能付费。

联邦从来没有门禁。 跨代理内存是产品，而不是追加销售。 它位于免费层并保留在这里。

一家人·一台乐器

波登管风琴是舰队乐器中的一种。 它的同级 Positif 是跨代理路由：允许车队执行的操作。 波登是跨代理记忆：舰队知道什么。 当舰队独立行动时，特雷穆兰特是指挥——而普雷斯坦特是他们面前的控制台。 各有自己的品牌；一台仪器。
